ENGLISH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only an action
   D. Only a joining word

2. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.

4. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   C. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.

5. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. Only one word repeated
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

6. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to : Stressed and unstressed words.
   B. Copy random text without understanding : Stressed and unstressed words.
   C. Use insults to “practise” : Stressed and unstressed words.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for : Stressed and unstressed words.

   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.

10. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library?
   B. Where is the Library
   C. Where is the library
   D. where is the library

11. When practising Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories, which approach is best? (1 mark)

13. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. happiness

14. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goes
   B. went
   C. going
   D. goed
